archetypes.name: parser-logic
archetypes.rationale: The plan_contains_standalone_scout_manifest function uses raw_decode scanning and a fence-toggle heuristic; correctness of fence detection and JSON-in-plan detection needs close scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect `scripts/parse-drafter-output.py` changes, especially the `plan_contains_standalone_scout_manifest` function. Verify that the backtick-fence toggle correctly handles opening fences with info strings (e.g. ` ```json `) and that `json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode` iterating over every `{` position cannot produce false positives on plan prose that happens to include a dict literal. Verify the sentinel position guard `any(i < pe[0] for i in scb + sce)` covers all the fatal cases described in the plan (scout inside summary, scout inside plan, scout before plan). Check whether the `remove_scout_candidate()` call placement and the `scout_fail_reason='absent'` branch are reachable in the correct order. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: threading-integration
archetypes.rationale: --scout-manifest-path is now a required flag in both launchers; if step2-implement.sh omits it, both launchers exit 2, silently breaking all Codex/Cursor runs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the call sites that invoke `launch-codex-implement.sh` and `launch-cursor-implement.sh` — primarily `skills/implement/scripts/step2-implement.sh` — to confirm `--scout-manifest-path` is passed on every invocation path (initial run, resume, cap-hit, and any other branch). Verify the eligibility marker (`step2-external-scout-eligible.txt`) is written after, not before, the sidecar is validated, so `run-step5-review.sh` cannot read a stale marker. Check that the three fallback cleanup paths (Claude fallback, manifest-invalid recovery, Cursor presence fallback) all remove both the sidecar and the eligibility marker atomically relative to each other. Check for any branch where the marker could be written but the sidecar not normalized, leaving `dispatch-panel.sh` to receive a raw uncapped JSON blob. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bundled-scope
archetypes.rationale: The render-review-phase-detail.sh Gantt chart additions appear bundled with the scout manifest threading, introducing significant unrelated scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the `scripts/render-review-phase-detail.sh` and `scripts/render-review-phase-detail.md` changes for architectural coherence with the rest of the diff. The Gantt chart feature (`--no-gantt`, `round_windows_file`, Mermaid block generation, the `round-windows.tsv` accumulation) appears to be a separate concern from the scout manifest threading that is the stated goal of this change. Assess whether the `--no-gantt` flag plumbed through `python/progress_report.py` and tested in `python/test_progress_report.py` constitutes unintended scope coupling that violates the SIMPLE scope designation, and whether any of those changes are load-bearing for the scout feature or are genuinely independent additions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
